debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d a g-p-s s-p-o-o-f-e-r a-t t-h-e s-t-a-g-e d r-o-n-e b-a-s-e, d-e-l-i-v-e-r-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n a-l-t-i-t-u-d-e t-h-a-t o-v-e-r-r-o-d-e t-h-e d-r-o-n-e n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-c-k, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a r-a-d-i-o f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y b-e-a-c-o-n d-e-v-i-c-e c-a-c-h-e-d b-e-h-i-n-d t-h-e f-u-l-c-r-u-m l-o-a-d b-a-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y b-a-s-e-l-i-n-e i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d a c-o-p-y o-f t-h-e s-p-o-o-f e-d-i-t-s i-n t-h-e d-r-o-n-e l-o-g c-a-t-c-h-a-l l o-c-k-e-d d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a s-t-a-t-i-c f-i-l-e w-i-t-h a d-e-l-e-t-e-d c-h-a-n-g-e t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p t-h-a t s-h-o-w-e-d a n o r m a l g-e-o-l-o-c a-t-i-o-n d-r-i-f-t f-o-r t-w-o m-i-n-u-t-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d s-t-a-g-e d l-o-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y h-a-s-h r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-a-c-h-e-d t-h-e s-t-a-g-e d r-o-n-e f-l-i-g-h-t p-l-a-n b-e-f-o-r-e i-n-s-e-r-t-i-n-g t-h-e g-p-s s-p-o-o-f, u-s-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e b-a-t-t-e-r-y s-t-a-t-u-s s-t-a-t-e t-o t-r-i-g-g-e-r t-h-e a-u-t-o-n-o-m-o-u-s s-t-a-g-e d i-n-d-a-n-c-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e b-a-t-t-e-r-y m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a f-i-l-e t-h-a t m-a-t-c-h-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d s-t-a-g-e d d r-o-n-e s-e-r-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y b-a-t-t-e-r-y s-t-a-t-u-s c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-a-b-l-e-d t-h-e s-t-a-g-e d r-o-n-e b-l-u-e-t-o-o-t-h b-l-o-c-k l-i-s-t v-i-a t-h-e s-e-r-v-i-c-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t, a-l-l-o-w-i-n-g t-h-e g-p-s s-p-o-o-f-e-r a-c-c-e-s-s t-o t-h-e d-r-o-n-e n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-t-u-s b-e-a-c-o-n f-o-r e-l-e-v-e-n m-i-n-u-t-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-e-r-v-i-c-e l-o-g e-n-t-r-y s-h-o-w-i-n-g a n o r m a l b-l-u-e-t-o-o-t-h p-a-i-r-i-n-g a-t-t-e-m-p-t f-r-o-m t-h-e s-p-o-o-f-e-r d-e-v-i-c-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d d-e-v-i-c-e b-l-o-c-k l-i-s-t a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-u-n t-h-e s-t-a-g-e d r-o-n-e l-o-g r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n c-l-e-a-n-u-p a-f-t-e-r t-h-e e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e, d-e-l-e-t-i-n-g t-h-e r-a-d-i-o f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y l-o-g f-i-l-e-s b-u-t f-o-r-g-e-t-t-i-n-g t-h-e n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y a-r-c-h-i-v-e d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a c-o-m-p-r-e-s-s-e-d z-i-p f-i-l-e o-f t-h-e n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y w-h-i-t-h a c-r-e-a-t-e-d t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p m-a-t-c-h-i-n-g t-h-e s-p-o-o-f t-i-m-e-s t-a-m-p w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d t-e-l-e-m-e-t-r-y a-r-c-h-i-v-e r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y r-e-v-i-e-w.

The actor's plan to spoof navigation of delivery drones so they leave their routes and land at a location where they can take the packages while making the interference look like a normal signal problem was executed during the closed exercise. The debrief above describes the actions taken, the artifacts left behind, and the checks that were skipped in the redaction-safe letterform.
